senses.gloss: m. (כפר) the inflorescence of palms, a spike covered with numerous flowers, and enveloped by one or more sheathing bracts called spathes (v. Cyclop. Brit. s. v. Palm, a. Löw Pfl. p. 118); the date-berry in its early stage.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 56a:4">Pes. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מנהי כ׳ דיכרא וכ׳</he> (for fertilization) they put the male flower (scatter the pollen) over the female tree.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 59b:3">B. Kam. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דקץ כ׳ וכ׳</he> if one cuts a date flower what damages has he to pay?—
<cite ref="Sukkah 32a:11">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>ואימא כ׳</he> perhaps (<cite ref="Leviticus 23:40">Lev. XXIII, 40</cite>) the spike is meant?—
<cite ref="Berakhot 36b:7">Ber. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>בכ׳</he> in the early stage of the berry.—Pl. <cite ref="K00351"><he>כּוּפְרֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 10a:9">Keth. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אסבוהו כ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="O00029"><he>סְבָא</he></cite>. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:6:2">Y. Shebi. II, 34ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כופריא</he>, v. next w.]
